youtube.title: 9 Hikers Cut Their Way Out of Their Own Tent. None Survived. | Dyatlov Pass
youtube.description:
In February 1959, nine experienced hikers led by Igor Dyatlov died in the northern Ural Mountains. Their tent had been cut open from the inside, and they fled into the snow without boots. Soviet investigators blamed 'a compelling natural force' and closed the file. A 2021 study by Johan Gaume (EPFL) and Alexander Puzrin (ETH Zurich) showed a small slab avalanche could explain much of it, but even they say no one really knows.

📂 Case File #046: The Dyatlov Pass

Sources: New Atlas, "Mystery Dyatlov Pass deaths may be explained by new scientific theory" (2021) https://newatlas.com/science/dyatlov-pass-incident-mystery-new-theory ; History.com, "The Dyatlov Pass Incident" https://www.history.com/news/dyatlov-pass-incident-soviet-hiker-death-mystery
Image: search-party photograph of the tent, 1959 (public domain).
